attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as the DHCP server for the private network shared with node2/node3 (eth1/enp8s0, 192.168.50.0/24). Added a dnsmasq pool (192.168.50.100-249) for the general pool and a static host reservation binding node2's MAC to 192.168.50.50, so node2 always gets the same address while node3 draws from the pool. Verified this held across repeated lease renewals and across full reboots of node1, node2, and node3. Completed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot identity and full recovery of network config, DHCP service, and leases on each.
